english.toefl: 5.0 on or after January21,2026; 90 iBT earlier; 577 paper

Qualifying English-medium degree/home-language exemptions may apply. Unofficial scores for review; official after admission.

applicationFee.note: Central severe-financial-hardship waivers may be requested from program; program-specific, not guaranteed. International eligibility not expressly restricted; confirm.

documents: Statement of Objectives (1–2 pages): research experience, academic goals, faculty of interest

funding.note: Competitive teaching/research assistantships and/or monthly stipends, based on available funding. Discuss financial assistance during application; universal support not promised.
